title: Audit page: Refer a business is now a living panel with a 2-step form and a tracker
summary: On every audit page the referral offer left the card grid and got its own panel: a 3-step path (you introduce, we talk to them, you earn a share) that lights up as you scroll, a 2-step form with live checks, a clear done state, and 'Your introductions' with the real status of each business. Open any audit page and scroll to How do you want to grow?
